source_basis: Local agent-loop design, ProgressTracker, ContextEngine and existing loop-control tests.

progress_detection.basis: Validated complete result content; excludes transport metadata, random evidence IDs, query wording and ranking score changes.

limitations: Progress rules cover the three named tools; asynchronous polling needs a tool-specific contract.
Character-based context limits and reported token-usage limits are separate budgets.
A response can exceed a usage limit before the runtime checks it; provider-side request limits and deadlines are still needed.
The durable wall-time budget includes paused downtime.
This summary does not claim production diagnostic accuracy or present an incident trace.
privacy: Only implementation contracts are included; no company records, raw incidents or conversation text.
